import heapq

class NetworkFlow:
    def __init__(self, nodes):
        self.V = nodes
        self.edges_descriptor = []
        self.adj_list = [[] for _ in range(nodes)]

    def link(self, u, v, capacity, cost):
        idx = len(self.edges_descriptor)
        self.edges_descriptor.append((u, len(self.adj_list[u])))
        self.adj_list[u].append(self._Link(v, len(self.adj_list[v]), capacity, cost))
        self.adj_list[v].append(self._Link(u, len(self.adj_list[u]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return idx

    class Connection:
        def __init__(self, start, end, capacity, flow, cost):
            self.start = start
            self.end = end
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def fetch(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edges_descriptor[i]
        fwd = self.adj_list[u][pos]
        bwd = self.adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev]
        return self.Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost)

    def enumerate(self):
        out = []
        for i in range(len(self.edges_descriptor)):
            u, pos = self.edges_descriptor[i]
            fwd = self.adj_list[u][pos]
            bwd = self.adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev]
            out.append(self.Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost))
        return out

    def _adjust(self, src, dst):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_queue = [False] * self.V
        heap = [src]
        self.dist[src] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.in_queue[v]:
                continue
            self.in_queue[v] = True
            if v == dst:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj_list[v])):
                e = self.adj_list[v][i]
                if self.in_queue[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                rc = e.cost - self.potential[e.to] + self.potential[v]
                if self.dist[e.to] > self.dist[v] + rc:
                    self.dist[e.to] = self.dist[v] + rc
                    self.parent[e.to] = v
                    self.parent_edge[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.dist[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.in_queue[dst]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.V):
            if not self.in_queue[i]:
                continue
            self.potential[i] -= self.dist[dst] - self.dist[i]
        return True

    def trade(self, src, dst, cap_limit=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.V
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_queue = [False] * self.V
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        prev_cost = -1
        points = [(total_flow, total_cost)]
        while total_flow < cap_limit:
            if not self._adjust(src, dst):
                break
            bottleneck = cap_limit - total_flow
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, self.adj_list[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge[node]].cap)
                node = self.parent[node]
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                e = self.adj_list[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge[node]]
                e.cap -= bottleneck
                self.adj_list[node][e.rev].cap += bottleneck
                node = self.parent[node]
            d = -self.potential[src]
            total_flow += bottleneck
            total_cost += bottleneck * d
            if prev_cost == d:
                points.pop()
            points.append((total_flow, total_cost))
            prev_cost = d
        return points

    def push(self, src, dst, cap_limit=4294967295):
        return self.trade(src, dst, cap_limit)[-1]

    class _Link:
        def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
            self.to = to
            self.rev = rev
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

b1, b2, b3 = map(int, input().split())

g.link(0, 1, a1, 0)

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

class NetworkFlow {
public:
    struct Link {
        int to;
        int rev;
        uint32_t cap;
        int cost;
        Link(int t, int r, uint32_t c, int cs) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(cs) {}
    };

    struct Connection {
        int start;
        int end;
        uint32_t capacity;
        uint32_t flow;
        int cost;
        Connection(int s, int e, uint32_t cap, uint32_t fl, int cs) 
            : start(s), end(e), capacity(cap), flow(fl), cost(cs) {}
    };

    int V;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges_descriptor;
    vector<vector<Link>> adj_list;

    NetworkFlow(int nodes) : V(nodes), adj_list(nodes) {}

    int link(int u, int v, uint32_t capacity, int cost) {
        int idx = edges_descriptor.size();
        edges_descriptor.push_back(make_pair(u, (int)adj_list[u].size()));
        adj_list[u].push_back(Link(v, (int)adj_list[v].size(), capacity, cost));
        adj_list[v].push_back(Link(u, (int)adj_list[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        return idx;
    }

    Connection fetch(int i) {
        int u = edges_descriptor[i].first;
        int pos = edges_descriptor[i].second;
        Link& fwd = adj_list[u][pos];
        Link& bwd = adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev];
        return Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost);
    }

    vector<Connection> enumerate() {
        vector<Connection> out;
        for (int i = 0; i < edges_descriptor.size(); i++) {
            int u = edges_descriptor[i].first;
            int pos = edges_descriptor[i].second;
            Link& fwd = adj_list[u][pos];
            Link& bwd = adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev];
            out.push_back(Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost));
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool _adjust(int src, int dst) {
        dist.assign(V, UINT32_MAX);
        parent.assign(V, -1);
        parent_edge.assign(V, -1);
        in_queue.assign(V, false);
        priority_queue<pair<uint32_t, int>, vector<pair<uint32_t, int>>, greater<pair<uint32_t, int>>> heap;
        dist[src] = 0;
        heap.push(make_pair(0, src));
        
        while (!heap.empty()) {
            int v = heap.top().second;
            heap.pop();
            if (in_queue[v]) continue;
            in_queue[v] = true;
            if (v == dst) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj_list[v].size(); i++) {
                Link& e = adj_list[v][i];
                if (in_queue[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                uint32_t rc = (uint32_t)e.cost - potential[e.to] + potential[v];
                if (dist[e.to] > dist[v] + rc) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[v] + rc;
                    parent[e.to] = v;
                    parent_edge[e.to] = i;
                    heap.push(make_pair(dist[e.to], e.to));
                }
            }
        }
        if (!in_queue[dst]) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
            if (!in_queue[i]) continue;
            potential[i] -= (int)(dist[dst] - dist[i]);
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<pair<uint32_t, long long>> trade(int src, int dst, uint32_t cap_limit = UINT32_MAX) {
        potential.assign(V, 0);
        dist.assign(V, UINT32_MAX);
        parent.assign(V, -1);
        parent_edge.assign(V, -1);
        in_queue.assign(V, false);
        uint32_t total_flow = 0;
        long long total_cost = 0;
        int prev_cost = -1;
        vector<pair<uint32_t, long long>> points;
        points.push_back(make_pair(total_flow, total_cost));
        
        while (total_flow < cap_limit) {
            if (!_adjust(src, dst)) break;
            uint32_t bottleneck = cap_limit - total_flow;
            int node = dst;
            while (node != src) {
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, adj_list[parent[node]][parent_edge[node]].cap);
                node = parent[node];
            }
            node = dst;
            while (node != src) {
                Link& e = adj_list[parent[node]][parent_edge[node]];
                e.cap -= bottleneck;
                adj_list[node][e.rev].cap += bottleneck;
                node = parent[node];
            }
            int d = -potential[src];
            total_flow += bottleneck;
            total_cost += (long long)bottleneck * d;
            if (prev_cost == d) {
                points.pop_back();
            }
            points.push_back(make_pair(total_flow, total_cost));
            prev_cost = d;
        }
        return points;
    }

    pair<uint32_t, long long> push(int src, int dst, uint32_t cap_limit = UINT32_MAX) {
        auto result = trade(src, dst, cap_limit);
        return result.back();
    }

private:
    vector<int> potential;
    vector<uint32_t> dist;
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<int> parent_edge;
    vector<bool> in_queue;
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a1, a2, a3;
    int b1, b2, b3;
    cin >> a1 >> a2 >> a3;
    cin >> b1 >> b2 >> b3;

    NetworkFlow g(8);
    g.link(0, 1, a1, 0);
    g.link(0, 2, a2, 0);
    g.link(0, 3, a3, 0);
    g.link(4, 7, b1, 0);
    g.link(5, 7, b2, 0);
    g.link(6, 7, b3, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
            int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
            g.link(i, j, INT_MAX, cost);
        }
    }

    auto result = g.push(0, 7);
    int ans1 = result.second;
    int ans2 = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1);
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
